palettes.A: muted warm earth/neutral granite, no orange cast
palettes.B: cool charcoal/gray earth, no saturated blue

output: 1024x1024 texture exports; preserve native image dimensions/hash and disclose any mechanical resampling
tone: H1/actual in-game hand-painted matte materials, background albedo kept legible under dark lighting; no baked directional light, vignette or glossy reflection
density_note: #120 audit band is400~900 px/unit. #195's3m estimate is below its400 lower bound for1024. Provide2.5m recommendation, preserve the3m alternative as an explicit follow-up shader decision.

raw_policy: If originals/card payload reaches50MB or an original reaches10MB, store raw outside Git via public Release/private Drive and record location/bytes/SHA. Do not duplicate all source originals in reports.
